root_cause: The LinkedIn revenue cockpit generated and prioritized evidence-backed actions, but the canonical social delivery path did not consume eligible cockpit actions. This left supported LinkedIn post-reply actions dependent on manual cockpit operation.
prevention_rules: The cockpit is an observability and exception surface, not the primary execution surface.
Eligible LinkedIn post-reply actions must be atomically claimed before any provider call.
Only provider capabilities actually available through the connected LinkedIn transport may execute automatically.
Unsupported DM and connection activation actions must remain explicit capability exceptions; never fabricate or bypass transport capabilities.
Provider acknowledgement and canonical outcome writeback are required before an action is marked executed.
Every new RPC used by material runtime code must be registered in the quality-surface contract.

production_readback.rule: Do not call the autopilot LIVE_PROVEN until the merged main function is deployed and an authenticated runtime invocation returns cockpit_autopilot evidence from production.
